AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Harvesting and Storage? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Harvesting and Storage.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Harvesting and Storage.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Harvesting and Storage.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Harvesting and Storage.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning the Kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning the Kitchen.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning the Kitchen.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning the Kitchen.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning the Kitchen.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving animal products? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving animal products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving animal products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving animal products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving animal products.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Poultry Rearing in a Fold? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Poultry Rearing in a Fold.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Poultry Rearing in a Fold.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen and Backyard Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preparation of Animal Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preparation of Animal Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preparation of Animal Products.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preparation of Animal Products.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preparation of Animal Products.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal 11 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Cleaning the Kit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Preparing a Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning the Kitchen and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
